ingredients: Enough apples to fill 7 quart jars, peeled and sliced
directions: Fill 7 quart jars with peeled and sliced apples.
Combine water, sugar, cornstarch, apple pie spice, and margarine in a saucepan. Cook filling until thickened.
Pour filling equally over apples in jars.
Place filled jars in hot water in a pressure canner.
Pressure can for 10 minutes at 5 pounds of pressure.
Cool in canner, then remove and store.
